title: WERE the wheels of this giant stone chariot actually built to turn? #Shorts
description:
WERE the wheels of this giant stone chariot actually built to turn?

The stone wheels of the Vittala temple chariot were originally carved independently and mounted onto axles so they could rotate. Government preservation cemented the axles in the 20th century to prevent tourist wear, giving rise to the myth that they were always static.

Produced by ARIA Sacred Heritage AI. Subscribe for the full 52-minute documentary.
